subject: Elementary School Space Planning and Budget Reconciliation
overview: The Committee approved the FY25 budget reconciliation and voted to relocate preschool classrooms to address overcrowding at the Roberts Elementary School.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, including bills, grants, field trips, and minutes from several previous meetings.

items.title: Student Achievement Recognitions
items.summary: Recognized the Middle School Orchestra for a gold medal rating, the eSports team for a state championship, and various winter and spring athletic league champions.

items.title: Staff and Administrator Recognitions
items.summary: Honored retiring staff members and recognized departing administrators Dr. Peter Cushing and Paul Teixeira as they depart for new superintendencies.

items.title: Policy IKF Health and Physical Education Update
items.summary: Approved updates to Policy IKF to allow students more flexibility in meeting health and physical education requirements through independent study and electives.

items.title: FY25 Budget Amendment and Reconciliation
items.summary: Approved the FY25 budget reconciliation plan, which utilizes revolving funds and free cash for capital needs following city funding adjustments.

items.title: Elementary Space Capacity Adjustment
items.summary: Approved relocating Medford Early Education Program (MEEP) classrooms from the Roberts to the Missituk and added two staff positions at the Roberts to address overcrowding.

items.title: Strategic Space Planning Task Force
items.summary: Approved the creation of a task force comprising staff and caregivers to review findings from an upcoming facilities utilization study.
